rappel-produit.tagline: Check product recalls in an instant
rappel-produit.description: Stay informed for safe consumption. Scan a product, search by name or category, and instantly find out if it's subject to an official recall. Protect your loved ones by sharing the info in one click! All data comes from the official government website rappel.conso.gouv.fr.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: This privacy policy describes how Rappel Produit, developed by Yoan Soussand, collects, uses and protects your personal information. By using the application, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.content: Rappel Produit does not create user accounts and does not sell your personal data. The application collects anonymous usage data via Firebase Analytics (see section 15) and, if you have not purchased premium, advertising identifiers via Google AdMob (see sections 4 to 6). The camera is used solely for barcode scanning: no images are stored. Your preferences, last visit date and watchlist are stored locally on your device.

sections.title: 3. Government data
sections.content: Product recall information comes exclusively from the official French government website rappel.conso.gouv.fr. This data is public and Rappel Produit does not store it on its own servers.

sections.title: 4. Google AdMob advertising
sections.content: Rappel Produit is funded through advertising via Google AdMob. Ads are disabled if you have purchased premium (see section 14). Google AdMob may collect and use data to serve personalized ads, including your advertising identifier (IDFA), approximate location data and anonymous usage data. This data is processed in accordance with Google's privacy policy: policies.google.com/privacy

sections.title: 5. App Tracking Transparency (ATT)
sections.content: In accordance with Apple's requirements, Rappel Produit will ask for permission to track your activity via Google AdMob. If you decline, non-personalized ads will be shown. You can change your choice from Settings → Privacy → Tracking.

sections.title: 6. GDPR consent — Google AdMob
sections.content: For users in the European Economic Area, Rappel Produit uses Google's UMP SDK to collect your consent in accordance with GDPR before any advertising data collection.

sections.title: 7. Data sharing
sections.content: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. The only data shared are anonymous advertising identifiers transmitted to Google AdMob for advertising delivery, subject to your consent.

sections.title: 8. Third-party services
sections.content: Rappel Produit uses Google AdMob (advertising, if not premium), Firebase Analytics (anonymous usage analytics), the official government API rappel.conso.gouv.fr (recall data) and the iTunes API (update check). These services are subject to their own privacy policies.

sections.title: 9. Security
sections.content: Rappel Produit does not store any personal data on its own servers. However, certain data (preferences, watchlist, last visit date) is stored locally on your device via iOS storage (UserDefaults). Communications with the government API and update checks (iTunes API) are made via secure HTTPS connections.

sections.title: 10. Your rights (GDPR)
sections.content: In accordance with GDPR, you have the rights of access, rectification, erasure and objection. To exercise your rights regarding Google AdMob data, visit myaccount.google.com/data-and-privacy.

sections.title: 11. Children
sections.content: Rappel Produit is not intended for children under 13 years of age due to the presence of Google AdMob advertising. We encourage you to configure parental controls on the device.

sections.title: 12. Changes
sections.content: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy, particularly in the event of changes to Google AdMob's terms of use.

sections.title: 13. Contact
sections.content: For any questions regarding this privacy policy, contact us at yoansoussand@gmail.com or through the application page on the App Store.

sections.title: 14. In-app purchases
sections.content: Rappel Produit offers an optional one-time purchase through the Apple App Store to remove ads and support the project. The purchase identifier is com.yoansoussand.rappelproduit.premium (€2.99). Payment is entirely handled by Apple. No payment data is collected by the application. No account is created. The purchase can be restored on another device via "Restore Purchase". All features remain available for free.

sections.title: 15. Usage analytics (Firebase Analytics)
sections.content: The application uses Firebase Analytics (Google) to measure usage anonymously: screens visited, sessions, searches, scans and interactions. This data does not allow you to be personally identified. Google policy: policies.google.com/privacy

sections.title: 16. Notifications and watchlist
sections.content: You can enable local notifications: weekly reminders (Monday to Friday at 6:30 PM) and alerts when your watched products are subject to a new recall. These notifications are managed entirely by iOS, with no server involved. The brands, products and barcodes you watch are stored only on your device. The application may check for new recalls in the background via iOS mechanisms (BGAppRefresh); iOS decides when to run, with no fixed schedule guaranteed.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: This privacy policy describes how Convert Scanner to PDF (PhotoToPDF), developed by Yoan Soussand, collects, uses and protects your personal information. By using the application, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.content: Convert Scanner to PDF does not create user accounts and does not sell your personal data. Documents you create (photos, scans and PDFs) are stored locally on your device. The application may collect anonymous usage data via Firebase Analytics and, if you have not purchased Premium, advertising identifiers via Google AdMob.

sections.title: 3. Local storage
sections.content: Your PDF files, folders, signature and preferences are stored locally in the app sandbox on your device. We do not upload your documents to our own servers.

sections.title: 4. Camera and photo library
sections.content: The camera and photo library are used only to capture or import images that you choose to convert into PDF pages. Images are processed on your device. No image is sent to us for storage.

sections.title: 5. Google AdMob advertising
sections.content: The free version may display ads via Google AdMob. Ads are disabled if you purchase Premium (lifetime purchase or subscription). Google AdMob may collect and use data to serve ads, including your advertising identifier (IDFA), approximate location and anonymous usage data, in accordance with Google's privacy policy: policies.google.com/privacy

sections.title: 6. App Tracking Transparency (ATT)
sections.content: In accordance with Apple's requirements, the application may ask for permission to track your activity for personalized ads. If you decline, non-personalized ads may still be shown. You can change your choice in Settings → Privacy → Tracking.

sections.title: 7. GDPR consent — Google AdMob
sections.content: For users in the European Economic Area, the application uses Google's UMP SDK to collect your consent in accordance with GDPR before any advertising data collection.

sections.title: 8. In-app purchases and subscriptions
sections.content: Convert Scanner to PDF offers optional Premium access through the Apple App Store: a lifetime non-consumable purchase and auto-renewable subscriptions (monthly and annual) to remove ads and unlock unlimited pages. Payments are entirely handled by Apple. No payment card data is collected by the application. Purchases can be restored via "Restore purchases". Subscription management is done in your Apple ID settings.

sections.title: 9. Third-party services
sections.content: The application may use Google AdMob (advertising, if not Premium), Firebase Analytics / Crashlytics (anonymous analytics and crash reports) and Apple frameworks (StoreKit, VisionKit, Photos). These services are subject to their own privacy policies.

sections.title: 10. Data sharing
sections.content: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. The only data that may be shared are anonymous advertising or analytics identifiers transmitted to Google, subject to your consent where required.

sections.title: 11. Security
sections.content: Your documents remain on your device. Communications with third-party SDKs use secure connections when applicable. Uninstalling the app deletes locally stored app data from the device.

sections.title: 12. Your rights (GDPR)
sections.content: In accordance with GDPR, you have the rights of access, rectification, erasure and objection. To exercise rights regarding Google advertising data, visit myaccount.google.com/data-and-privacy. You can also delete app data by uninstalling the application.

sections.title: 13. Children
sections.content: Convert Scanner to PDF is not intended for children under 13 years of age due to the presence of advertising in the free version. We encourage parental controls on the device.

sections.title: 14. Changes
sections.content: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy, particularly if advertising, analytics or purchase terms change.

sections.title: 15. Contact
sections.content: For any questions regarding this privacy policy, contact us at yoansoussand@gmail.com or through the application page on the App Store.
